units.source_text: 这一次出门是微行，前驱者也只是几个心腹人。

en.t: This outing was made incognito, with only a few trusted men going ahead of him.

units.source_text: 悄悄地前行，到达大堰已是黄昏时分。

en.t: They went forward quietly, and by the time they reached Oi it was already dusk.

units.source_text: 从前流寓明石浦时，身穿旅装便服，明石姬已赞叹他的风姿之美，乃见所未见。

en.t: Long ago, when he was living in exile at Akashi Bay, even in plain traveling clothes Lady Akashi had marveled at the beauty of his bearing, saying she had never seen anything like it.

units.source_text: 何况现在身穿官袍，加之用心打扮，其神情之艳丽竟是盖世无双，

en.t: How much more so now, dressed in court robes and carefully arrayed, when the radiant elegance of his expression was truly without equal in the world,

units.source_text: 她见了心惊目眩，心头的愁云忽然消散，不觉喜形于色。

en.t: and when she saw him, her heart was startled and her eyes dazzled; the clouds of sorrow in her breast suddenly cleared, and joy showed on her face before she knew it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子到了邸内，觉得一切都可喜可爱。

en.t: When Prince Genji entered the residence, everything seemed pleasing and lovable to him.

units.source_text: 看见了小女公子，尤为感动，深悔以前多时隔绝，何等可惜！

en.t: Seeing the little princess moved him especially deeply, and he bitterly regretted that he had been separated from her for so long; what a pity it had been.

units.source_text: 他想：“葵姬所生的夕雾，世人盛称其为美男子，

en.t: He thought, "People loudly praise Yugiri, the son born to Lady Aoi, as a handsome young man,

units.source_text: 不过是为了他是太政大臣的外孙，权势所关，不得不颂扬耳。

en.t: but that is only because he is the grandson of the Grand Minister, and with such power involved they cannot help praising him.

units.source_text: 这小女公子年仅三岁，便已长得如此美丽，将来可想而知了。”

en.t: This little princess is only three years old, yet she is already so beautiful; one can imagine what she will become."

units.source_text: 但见她向人天真烂漫地微笑，那娇痴模样实在教人爱杀！

en.t: When she smiled innocently at people, her sweet, childlike charm was truly irresistible.

units.source_text: 那乳母从前下乡之时，形容甚是憔悴，现已养得很丰丽了。

en.t: The nurse, who had looked terribly worn when she first went down to the countryside, had now been cared for until she had become full and handsome.

units.source_text: 她叨叨絮絮地把年来小女公子的情状告诉源氏公子。

en.t: She told Prince Genji, at great and rambling length, all about how the little princess had been in recent years.

units.source_text: 公子想象她在那盐灶旁边的村居生涯，甚觉可怜，便用善言抚慰。

en.t: The prince pictured her life in the village beside the salt kilns and felt very sorry for her, so he comforted her with kind words.

units.source_text: 又对明石姬说：“这地方也很偏僻，我来去不甚方便。

en.t: He also said to Lady Akashi, "This place too is rather remote, and it is not very convenient for me to come and go.

units.source_text: 还是迁居到我原定的东院去吧。”

en.t: It would be better for you to move to the eastern wing that I had originally planned for you."

units.source_text: 明石姬答道：“现在初到，还很生疏，且过几时，再作道理。”

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "I have only just arrived and am still unfamiliar with everything. Let some time pass, and then we can decide what to do."

units.source_text: 这一晚两人娓娓话情，直至天明。

en.t: That night the two of them spoke tenderly of their feelings until dawn.
